monthlyEmailMix.description: Target email type distribution per 4-week month across all personas

slots.label: Solution / Capsule Email
slots.description: Show how AK pieces solve a real wardrobe problem — '5 days, 9 pieces, zero stress' capsule logic. Persona: Polished Professional or Emerging Leader. Occasion-specific (board meeting, client travel, office-to-dinner). Component-story preferred when showcasing category depth (all blazers, all flats, all totes).

slots.label: Category Spotlight
slots.description: Feature one product category in depth — rotate through Handbags, Shoes, Watches, Jewelry, Clothing. Show range within the category (3-6 options at varied price points). Lean on the 883-product catalog depth. Link copy to collection page.

slots.label: Persona Moment Email
slots.description: Write directly to one persona's specific life moment — salary negotiation outfit, work travel packing list, back-to-school morning routine, holiday party circuit. Name the moment precisely. Rotate through all 4 personas over the month.

categoryRotation.description: Ensure each category gets a spotlight email at least once per cycle
categoryRotation.rationale: Shoes (211 in-stock) and Handbags are the highest-revenue accessory categories and resonate across all personas. Jewelry (284 in-stock) drives add-on and gifting purchases. Watches are the aspiration/occasion category. Clothing spotlights reinforce AK as a full outfit destination, not just accessories.

personaRotation.description: All 4 personas should be the primary target in at least one email and one IG post per month

personas.name: The Polished Professional
topTopics: pieces that transition desk to dinner

instagramWeeklyMix.description: Target IG post type distribution per week — 5 posts total

slots.label: Product Feature
slots.description: Clean product shot with precise occasion copy and styling context. Name the specific moment — 'The bag for the long-haul flight' not 'Shop our travel edit.' Tag the product. Price in caption.

slots.label: Outfit / Styling Post
slots.description: 2-3 AK pieces styled into a complete look for a named occasion. Show the blazer with the pant AND the shoe. Short declarative caption, no more than 3 lines. One strong hook sentence.

slots.label: Brand POV / Editorial
slots.description: Brand voice content — no hard product push. A manifesto line, a styling truth, a behind-the-design thought. This is the post that earns saves and shares. Tone: authoritative, considered, never self-congratulatory.

priority: If a campaign is active: reinforce the campaign message and week's arc theme
If a category spotlight email is going out this week: match hero to that category
Default: feature the week's highest-priority persona moment with a complete outfit visual

globalRules: Every email must feature at least one clothing item (dress, blazer, jacket, pant, skirt) — never an accessories-only email
No single category should represent more than 60% of featured products across all content in one week
The subject line must match what is actually in the email — if it claims '3 looks' there must be exactly 3 looks
Every Instagram outfit post must name a specific occasion, not a generic one ('the Tuesday client lunch', not 'work')
The Polished Professional and Emerging Leader personas together should be the target of at least 3 of every 4 emails — they are the primary commercial audience
Jewelry and shoes should appear in at least 50% of email looks as add-on opportunity items
Category spotlight emails should reference the Shopify collection URL in the CTA, not the homepage
Copy tone across all channels: short declarative sentences, no exclamation points, no words: fresh, effortless, trendy, stunning, must-have, chic, vibrant
